state.goal: Small maintainable portfolio demo for a venture analyst. Three assumptions, fictional startup sources, visible contradictions, next useful question, a new free-text note updates the assessment.
state.plan: One TypeScript app, server-only Jev relation judgments per source and assumption; deterministic conflict-preserving aggregation and authored next questions; no uploads, auth system, database or agents. Fictional sources labeled. Preserve old results during errors, show source text.

alternatives.bounded: Prepared fictional case + free text; one end-to-end flow.
alternatives.broad: Arbitrary PDF upload, multi-startup CRM and autonomous research.

scope.instructions: Which option in `alternatives` better satisfies `goal` with minimal code?

risk.instructions: Which failure is most important to prevent in `plan` given `goal`?

criteria.false_verification: Presenting a source assertion as a verified business fact.

note: Jev advisory judgments, not approval or proof of implementation.
